query:
SELECT 
  enrichmentStatus,
  CASE WHEN briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_brief' ELSE 'no_brief' END as brief_status,
  CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_approach' ELSE 'no_approach' END as approach_status,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId = 1110002
GROUP BY enrichmentStatus, brief_status, approach_status
ORDER BY count DESC;
